film.title: Slowly, Slowly
film.logline: A grandmother's coffee ceremony, and the proverb she repeated to an impatient child, follow that child into a fast city life.
film.audience: Young Ethiopians aged 18-35 at home and in the diaspora, who grew up around the buna ceremony and now live fast city lives; watched on a phone, vertical, in a feed or forwarded on Telegram.
film.intent: When it ends, the viewer should feel the warmth of being made to wait as a child, and want to slow down and call an elder this week.

shots.reason: Establishing shot: tells the viewer where and when (highland town, dawn) before any person appears.
shots.image_prompt: extreme wide view of misty green Ethiopian highland hills at dawn, a small house with a tin roof among eucalyptus trees, thin smoke rising from the house, sun just rising
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, mist drifting, smoke rising gently, fixed horizon
shots.narration: በልጅነቴ፣ በአያቴ ቤት፣ ጠዋት በቡና ሽታ ይጀምር ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: When I was a child, at my grandmother's house, mornings began with the smell of coffee.

shots.reason: Introduces Emama and the ritual space (grass, charcoal, jebena) in one medium shot.
shots.image_prompt: {emama} sitting on a low wooden stool, spreading fresh green grass on the floor, a black clay jebena coffee pot beside a small charcoal stove, inside a simple mud-walled room
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly scatters grass with one hand, camera fixed
shots.subtitle_en: Emama spread fresh grass and set out the jebena.

shots.reason: Close detail of her hands: the care and slowness of the work, without needing a consistent face.
shots.image_prompt: extreme close-up of an elderly woman's wrinkled dark brown hands washing green coffee beans in a small wooden bowl of water
shots.motion_prompt: hands gently stir the beans, small ripples, camera fixed
shots.narration: አረንጓዴውን ቡና በእጃቸው ቀስ ብለው ያጥባሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: She washed the green beans slowly, by hand.

shots.reason: The roast is the sensory core of the memory (smell, smoke), so it gets its own close-up.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of coffee beans turning dark brown in a flat iron roasting pan over glowing charcoal, curling white smoke
shots.motion_prompt: smoke curls upward, beans shift slightly, slow push-in
shots.narration: ቡናው በምጣዱ ላይ ሲቆላ፣ ጭሱ ቤቱን በሙሉ ይሞላል።
shots.subtitle_en: As the beans roasted in the pan, the smoke filled the whole house.

shots.reason: Introduces the conflict: the child's impatience. Seen from behind so identity drift does not matter.
shots.image_prompt: {child}, fidgeting and leaning toward an old woman roasting coffee in the background, grass-covered floor, morning light through a small window
shots.motion_prompt: the child rocks impatiently, camera fixed
shots.narration: እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ቸኩዬ ነበር። «እማማ፣ መቼ ነው የሚደርሰው?»
shots.subtitle_en: But I was always in a hurry. "Emama, when will it be ready?"

shots.reason: The emotional peak and the title: her face and the proverb. Generated against the golden reference.
shots.image_prompt: {emama}, smiling warmly and looking down at someone off frame, soft smoke in the air, warm window light on her face
shots.motion_prompt: she smiles and slightly tilts her head, very slow push-in
shots.narration: እሳቸውም ፈገግ ብለው ይመልሳሉ፦ «ቀስ በቀስ፣ እንቁላል በእግሩ ይሄዳል።»
shots.subtitle_en: She would smile and answer: "Slowly, slowly, an egg will walk on its own legs."

shots.reason: Insert of mortar and incense: the ritual continues regardless of the child, which is the point of the proverb.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a wooden mortar and iron pestle crushing roasted coffee beans, a small clay incense burner with fragrant smoke beside it on fresh grass
shots.motion_prompt: pestle moves down slowly, incense smoke drifts, camera fixed
shots.subtitle_en: She pounded the beans in the mortar, and the incense smoked.

shots.reason: The pour names the three rounds, turning the ritual into the film's lesson about patience.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of coffee being poured from a black clay jebena in a thin stream into small white handleless cups on a wooden tray
shots.motion_prompt: thin stream of coffee pours, steam rises, camera fixed
shots.narration: አቦል፣ ቶና፣ በረካ። ሶስት ዙር፣ ሶስት ጊዜ ትዕግስት።
shots.subtitle_en: Abol, tona, bereka. Three rounds, three lessons in patience.

shots.reason: Wide shot of the community: the reward for waiting is togetherness; the music swells here.
shots.image_prompt: wide view of a warm mud-walled room, neighbours sitting on low stools around a coffee ceremony, laughing together, {emama} at the centre pouring coffee, golden light
shots.motion_prompt: people laugh gently, slow pan across the room
shots.narration: ጎረቤቶች ይሰበሰባሉ። ወሬ፣ ሳቅ፣ ምርቃት። ማንም አይቸኩልም።
shots.subtitle_en: The neighbours gathered. News, laughter, blessings. No one was in a hurry.

shots.reason: Time jump to the present: cool palette and solitude contrast with the warm crowded room before it.
shots.image_prompt: {adult} sitting alone by the window of a small city apartment at night, phone glowing in hand, city lights outside, cool blue light mixed with one warm lamp
shots.motion_prompt: city lights flicker softly, camera fixed
shots.narration: ዛሬ ሩቅ ከተማ ውስጥ እኖራለሁ። ሁሉም ነገር ፈጣን ነው።
shots.subtitle_en: Today I live in a faraway city. Everything is fast.

shots.reason: Match to s04: the same roasting action in the new life shows the habit was inherited.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of young hands roasting coffee beans in a small pan on a modern gas stove in a city kitchen, curling smoke, warm light returning
shots.motion_prompt: smoke curls upward, hands shake the pan gently, slow push-in
shots.narration: ግን ቡና ስቆላ፣ የእማማን ድምፅ እሰማለሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: But when I roast coffee, I hear Emama's voice.

shots.reason: Closing image and the proverb's echo; the theme returns and the film breathes before the end card.
